rationale: The approved UR and bounded impact support a scoped structured path, but new product semantics and three canonical owners rule out a narrow quick-task classification. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied; Verified Change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation for derived paths.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Canonical owner count is 3 across 3 source paths and 4 derived paths.
Deterministic validation is available, but deterministic propagation is false.
No runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact issup
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied.
Any broader impact requires fail-closed escalation.
This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate, not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
